description: This file contains utility functions for search functionalities within a CRM system, including building search queries, managing advanced and basic search conditions, handling search URLs, and interfacing with the database for search-related operations.

methods.name: getSearchListHeaderValues
methods.description: Retrieves list view header labels for search results, considering module-specific customizations and user privileges.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Constructs where conditions and URL parameters for basic or advanced search based on input parameters.

methods.name: get_usersid
methods.description: Returns where condition for user ID based on username search string.

methods.name: getValuesforColumns
methods.description: Generates where clause for specific columns based on search input, handling multiple fields if necessary.

methods.name: BasicSearch
methods.description: Creates basic search where condition based on search field and search string for a given module.

methods.name: getAdvSearchfields
methods.description: Provides HTML options for advanced search fields, tailored per module and user privileges.

methods.name: getcriteria_options
methods.description: Returns HTML options for different search criteria operators.

methods.name: getSearch_criteria
methods.description: Maps a search operator and value to a SQL where condition fragment.

methods.name: getWhereCondition
methods.description: Returns the complete SQL where condition for a module based on current search input, including advanced filters and dashboard filters.

methods.name: getSearchURL
methods.description: Builds URL parameters for search forms based on search input.

methods.name: getdashboardcondition
methods.description: Constructs search conditions specific to dashboard filters, e.g., for visual reports or widgets.

methods.name: str_replace_once
methods.description: Replaces only the first occurrence of a substring in a string.

methods.name: getUnifiedWhere
methods.description: Generates a unified search condition across multiple module fields, used for global search.

methods.name: getAdvancedSearchCriteriaList
methods.description: Parses and structures advanced search criteria groups and conditions into a list.

methods.name: generateAdvancedSearchSql
methods.description: Assembles SQL condition string from structured advanced search criteria groups.

methods.name: getAdvancedSearchComparator
methods.description: Maps a search comparison operator and value to corresponding SQL fragment.

methods.name: getAdvancedSearchValue
methods.description: Generates SQL fragment for a particular advanced search condition, considering module-specific logic and data types.

methods.name: getAdvancedSearchParentEntityValue
methods.description: Retrieves related entity names for parent records in advanced search filters.

methods.name: getTagWhere
methods.description: Returns SQL condition filtering entities tagged with a specific keyword.
